Workman's Pride Boots

Workman's Pride Boots is a boot crafted by the Trapper in Red Dead Redemption 2. It takes 1 Perfect Cow Hide and 1 Perfect Goat Hide and costs $28.00. Part of The Huntsman.

Type
Boot
Vendor
Trapper
Set
The Huntsman
Price
$28.00

Description

  • A lightweight item. Good in hot weather. No protection from the cold.

Ingredients

  • 1xPerfect Cow Hide
  • 1xPerfect Goat Hide
